label: D2 arrival in S2 early in the episode, strongest after a rare a1->S2 transition
explanation: Fires only at D2 and essentially only when the reached state is S2 (99.8% of mass); never at D1/GO, never in S1. It is restricted to early episode: rate 22% at trial 0, about 8% for trials 1-9, falls through trials 10-29 and is zero after trial ~35. Magnitude is largest for rare a1->S2 (84% of mass; all top windows are a1 S2R); common a2->S2 gives weaker, mostly low-quartile activations that die out sooner. The recorded predicate uses only observed variables (at D2 the choice and reached state are known; ep_trial is a time-in-episode correlate the agent can track). (D2 & S2 & ep_trial<30) has recall 0.99 but precision 0.22, so firing within the early-S2 condition is also sparse/graded; the exact cutoff in episode time is soft, so precision and recall are both incomplete (dev F1 0.71, mass recall 0.90).
